body:
My note from near lunchtime: the field trial crew carried sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.

I did not know where to put it after the shelves were cleared. There was still someone coming back for the answer written on it.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.
title: Near lunchtime: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
